notes.title: Update v3.5.9b Minor improvements
notes.notes:
* Very slightly reduced the swimming speed of the chapter 2 fish in the "toad" level difficulty setting.
* The rocks now continue to fall after the toad is crushed.

notes.title: Update v3.5.9 Bug fix and improvements
notes.notes:
* Fixed a bug in the drainpipe level which caused the toad to become permanently paralyzed and unable to move, if it ate the spider and then was stung by a centipede. This would only happen if playing on tadpole or egg difficulty levels.
* Added a new granddaughter to the list of names on the book cover.
* Graphically re-mastered the book pages for better clarity.
* The game now starts on "tadpole" rather than the very challenging "toad" difficulty level.
* Uploaded a "hints" game manual to the Steam store page.

notes.title: Update v3.5.8
notes.notes: * The player is now given a prompt if the "esc" key is pressed to quit the game.

notes.title: Update v3.5.7
notes.notes:
* Fixed a bug in which the goanna failed to take into account that the player had chosen easy difficulty mode, when commencing its run from the bushes.
* Moved the bolt slightly in the combine harvester level so that it is better aligned with the toad's tongue.
* Unless you are playing on hard difficulty mode, bullants will only bite if they are not carrying food back to their nest.

notes.title: Update 3.5.6
notes.notes: Game now adapts to full screen on higher resolution monitors. 100% Scaling still needs to be set manually through Windows display settings.

notes.title: Update note for V3.5.5
notes.notes: Fixed an anomaly which allowed the player to teleport to the next level, given the right set of circumstances.

notes.title: update 5.3.3
notes.notes:
* Increased the running speed of the nesting rat.
* Some further subtle visual improvements of the falling rocks.

notes.title: Update 3.5.2
notes.notes: Improved the look of the falling rocks in the "rat up a drainpipe" chapter.

notes.title: Patch 1.0_10/07/2022
notes.notes: Slightly increased the speed of the combine harvester conveyor in "egg" or easy mode and offset the difficulty by removing an extra spike. This now makes it slightly easier for younger players to successfully reach the platform.
